content.text:
**Jordi's deployment scope for the Zenod repository (from `Projects/Zenod.md`):**

Zenod is positioned as the open-source memory layer/framework/harness. It should be deployed as the core self-host instance (one Jordi self-host instance) together with Herald as the product built on top (separate Herald instance). Both launch together with multi-tenant support.

The other agents in the suite (Archus/Nearchus, Epaminon, Nectary, Phylax/Callisthenes, etc.) are distinct OWNERS/WORKERS units with their own bounded MCP surfaces and are not deployed from the Zenod repo; they remain separate while sharing the central vault substrate.

**Source citation:** `Projects/Zenod.md` (section on strategic direction and EPIC 2/3 packaging, referencing the 2026-07-05 Fable snapshot and 2026-07-31 direction; also cross-referenced in `Projects/Zenod/Hosted Zenod (M3) Multi-Tenant Plan.md`).
